question: Does the rebuild implement the Montoya extension API so Java extensions can be loaded? No extension runtime exists.
probes: Decision recorded: Rust cannot host Java Montoya extensions without an embedded JVM (jffi/JNI bridge or sidecar JVM process speaking IPC)
Path A: Rust-native extension host with a Montoya-shaped hook interface (HttpRequestResponse handlers, proxy handler registry) - extensions would be Rust/WASM, not Java
Path B: sidecar JVM process (java -jar bridge) exposing Burp's real Montoya API, WebProbe drives it over IPC
Neither path started; both need a design pass
resolution: RESOLVED (waves 20+30, 2026-11-15): Two-part answer. Path A (wave 20): WebProbe's own hook surface is Rust-native Montoya-shaped traits (ext_host.rs ProxyHooks) running in-process. Path B (wave 30): real Burp Montoya .jar extensions NOW LOAD through a sidecar JVM bridge - app/sidecar/MontoyaBridge.java launched in single-file source mode (java -cp burpsuite.jar MontoyaBridge.java <ext.jar>) against Burp's own Montoya API classes from /opt/BurpSuite/burpsuite.jar (1001 burp.api.montoya entries incl. sources). ServiceLoader finds BurpExtension; reflect-Proxy stubs back MontoyaApi (proxy().registerRequestHandler/ResponseHandler really register; logging() -> stderr; other accessors throw); ObjectFactoryLocator.FACTORY stub makes drop()/continueWith() factories work; InterceptedRequest/InterceptedResponse stubs expose the message fields. Rust JavaSidecar implements ProxyHooks over JSON-lines IPC, degrades to pass-through if the JVM dies; WEBPROBE_EXT_JAR registers at startup. Verified: standalone bridge smoke (drop on /admin-drop, continue on /normal, response hook, exit 0); suite test java_sidecar_runs_a_real_montoya_extension (242/242 green incl. real JVM); live proxy QA (:8123 - /normal -> 404 passthrough, /admin-drop/panel -> empty reply/dropped; Extensions tab lists 'Montoya bridge (demo-ext.jar) ProxyRequestHandler + ProxyResponseHandler (sidecar JVM)'). Honest v1 scope documented in-tab: Received halves only, no message editing, UI-coupled APIs throw. Evidence ev_1f11bbcae7093c78d66f9a757cb46baf2c4b39b268506c7f5473e8b275ad91d0, finding fnd_41.
